tagline: The Future of Hair Removal: Kabira Skincare Spray
intro: Say goodbye to razor burns and painful waxing sessions. The Kabira Skincare Hair Removal Spray is designed to give you a smooth, clean look without the discomfort. This 100 ml spray bottle is your convenient, at-home depilatory solution, effective for removing hair from most body areas.

p: Our advanced formula contains active depilatory agents (typically Thioglycolate-based, which breaks down the keratin protein in hair) that penetrate the hair shaft. After a brief waiting period, the hair is weakened and can be effortlessly wiped away with a cloth, leaving your skin beautifully bare and smooth.
Time-Saving: Full body hair removal takes less time compared to traditional methods.
Hydrating Finish: Unlike harsh methods that strip the skin, the formulation is designed to leave your skin feeling soft and nourished (based on similar products).
Versatile: Effective for arms, legs, chest, underarms, and back.
Spray: Hold the bottle about 5-10 cm away and spray generously to completely coat the hair. Do not rub in.
Wait: Leave the product on for the time specified on the back label (typically 5-10 minutes). Check a small area—if hair comes away easily, proceed.
Wipe & Rinse: Gently wipe the area with a wet towel or tissue in the opposite direction of hair growth. Rinse skin thoroughly with water and pat dry.
Important Safety Note: Always perform a patch test on a small area of skin 24 hours before full application, especially if you have sensitive skin.
